### Jesus Laments Over Jerusalem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-laments-over-jerusalem
Passage: Matthew 23:37-39
Points:
- Jesus grieves deeply over Jerusalem's long history of rejecting God's messengers and call to repentance.
- The imagery of a mother hen tenderly gathering chicks displays God's compassionate posture toward His people.
- Persistent refusal of Christ leads to spiritual desolation and righteous divine judgment.
- God takes no pleasure in the suffering or death of the wicked, even when exercising justice.
- Followers of Christ should respond to unrepentant sinners with brokenhearted grief rather than self-righteousness.
